note: Cameron County PA has no queryable zoning district layer. The county zoning ordinance (1987) and Emporium Borough zoning ordinance (1991) are published only as PDF documents; the Emporium zoning district map is referenced in the ordinance but not published as a service. Pennsylvania counties generally do not zone, and the other municipalities (Driftwood Borough, Shippen Township) defer to the county planning commission, which publishes no GIS zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Cameron County zoning returned no district layer. Regrid holds third-party parcel zoning only, which is not an official or queryable district layer.
